notes.title: Beta testing Twitch integration features
notes.notes: [p]We're currently testing out Twitch integration features on the beta branch. It's an open beta and streamers are encouraged to give it a go![/p][p][/p][p]To access the beta version of Zooika you just need to switch to the beta branch of the game. This community post has instructions on how to do that: [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2994730/discussions/0/592907032315663894/"]Twitch beta branch testing[/url] [/p][p][/p][p]We have two different game modes for streamers to try:[/p][p][/p][h3]Chat vs. Streamer[/h3][p]In this mode the streamer plays the game while chat can vote on 'events' to occur within the game, events include things like extra mice, buckets and watermelons! Along with a host of other effects (with more to come!). This is a fun and frantic mode that engages your chat to either help or hinder you (or usually both!)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159360/0358f685edd59233c2229fce51d32ffcb5a3e6ac.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Chat Plays[/h3][p]There is also a mode that allows Twitch chat to play the game with no input from the Streamer. This mode can be good as a 'be right back' screen for when a streamer needs to take a break. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159360/a8a95e49f3ff58dfd11fb74131054d9f4c3b0ef2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Known issues / Bugs[/h3][list][*][p]No testing has been done with a controller, so the UI probably doesn't work well with it yet (Twitch Plays features are disabled for Steam deck).[/p][/*][*][p]The restarting of the game in Twitch Plays mode mostly works, but there are some oddities that still need to be fixed.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Plans[/h3][list][*][p] More effects to vote for in the 'versus' mode.[/p][/*][*][p] Incorporation of user profile images and maybe streamer emotes within the game.[/p][/*][*][p] Leader boards for streamer games![/p][p] [/p][/*][/list][h2]Feedback[/h2][p]We'd love to hear your feedback, what works well, what doesn't really work, etc. You can use this [url="https://forms.gle/NdxY5fNHxi7cZf7T7" style="button"]feedback form[/url] or reply in the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2994730/discussions/0/"]community discussions[/url] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159360/69c6356a01dcd567ef509cc665c6a12bd705843f.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update notes for Zooika 1.0.3
notes.notes:
We've got a few more bug fixes in this update, along with several improvements to the in-game graphics and effects. Here's the details:

[list][*] Fixed issue with ripple effect being offset during dynamic camera zoom
[*] Fixed issue where the highest spawned animal would not always be included in the statistics at the end of a game
[*] Added additional sound effects to the bucket and mouse
[*] Added particle effects to bucket and mouse
[*] Added the keyboard shortcut 'Escape' key as an option for the pause menu. Previously this was only activated with 'P'
[*] Added hints to the main title screen to let players know about features that might have been missed.
[*] Improved visuals on multiplier so that it stands out a bit more
[*] Improved visuals and added sounds effects for bonus panels
[/list]

We're also working on a new feature for a future update: A 'Twitch Plays' mode, which, for streamers, will allow you to run the game on Twitch and let your chat play the game! 

If you're a streamer on Twitch and would like to help test out this new feature, contact us on Blue Sky or via the Community Hub!

notes.title: Update notes for Zooika 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Thanks to all that have been playing the game! It's great to see people enjoying [b]Zooika[/b]!

There's been a few, mostly minor issues spotted during its first week of release, and I've tried to address most of them with this patch. 

[list]
[*] Fixed 'explosive force' during merge spawn to stop it from affecting falling animals
[*] Mouse pointer no longer reactivates when switching to mouse input whilst within the play area.
[*] Fixed target assist setting being ignored, unless it was toggled off and on.
[*] Fixed issue where initial selection for custom game was incorrect.
[*] Fixed issue where initial selection for leader board display was incorrect.
[*] Tried to improve shader caching for initial play through smoothness.
[*] Fixed display issue on 'roundish' play area, lid was offset to the left.
[*] Fixed display issue where animals stayed in 'blinked' state when blinking was turned off.
[/list]
